name: Poll map
summary: A finished story poll about places drawn as a campus map from above, each spot a pin sized by its votes with friends' faces where they voted; a sticker invites everyone to meet at the winner and tapping it hops your face to the winning pin.
useWhen: my story poll on best study spot got 212 votes, show it on a map
turn the poll results into a meetup at the winner thursday
which dining hall won the story poll, and who's coming
story poll results for places but make it a map
everyone who voted for larkin should just come to fenwick lol
dontUseWhen: the poll is still open or has no places (use story-poll-plan or after-vote)
picking a time rather than a place (use meeting-time)
a poll between two plans with details (use story-poll-plan)

author.description: Whose story the poll is on

ago.description: How long ago the story went up, e.g. '5h'

options.description: 2 to 4 places with final vote counts and where each sits on the map in thousandths (x left to right, y top to bottom, 80 to 920)

kind.description: Which little drawing marks the pin

when.description: When everyone meets at the winner, e.g. 'Thursday 7pm'

friends.description: Friends in the chat, the spot they picked (0-based index into options) and an optional line in their own words

going.description: Names already going to the winner
